note: THE BOOK-CODE TABLE of the canon layers (run 2026-11-11-full-canons), an input of tools/build_canon_layers.py. The codes are eBible.org's own, as its verse-per-line files write them (SOL, EZE, JOE, NAH, MAR, JOH, PHI, JAM, 1JO, 2JO, 3JO for books of the 66; PSX is Psalm 151, PRM the Prayer of Manasseh, 4ES 2 Esdras, ESG Esther (Greek), DNG Daniel (Greek)), measured by checker-99 at the run's ledger line 3 and again by builder-31 on the pinned texts. A code in a file that is neither a book here nor skipped refuses the build. Each book is named by canon.py's name for it, so one lookup reaches the same book in every edition. 'within' says where an addition stands inside a book of the layer, 'in_the_66' where an edition prints it inside a book of the 66 that no layer holds; the keys are canon.py's names, and the build refuses a span the text does not hold.

the_66.why: a book of the 66, which the engine reads from its own World English Bible and never from a layer, so a layer never changes a reading of the 66

eng-web.name: World English Bible
eng-web.numbering: the World English Bible's own numbering, as eBible.org's eng-web file holds it

skip.4ES: 2 Esdras: canon.py lists it on no Catholic or Eastern Orthodox layer, so it is left out and named

engDRA.name: Douay-Rheims 1899 American Edition
engDRA.numbering: the Douay-Rheims's own numbering, which follows the Latin Vulgate's, as eBible.org's engDRA file holds it; it is not the World English Bible's numbering, and no verse is renumbered to match it
